principle_violations.reason: The VolumeCalculator and AreaCalculator classes have multiple responsibilities: they calculate sums of areas and volumes while being dependent on specific shapes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Consider separating the concerns of calculating areas and volumes into distinct calculators that do not inherit from one another, allowing them to focus only on their specific types of calculations.

principle_violations.reason: The sum methods in both calculators are tightly coupled to the shape implementations and need to be modified if new shapes or volume calculations are added, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce interfaces or abstract classes for Shape and VolumeShape, ensuring that new shapes can be added without requiring changes to the existing calculator code logic.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
